title: Bloody Spell
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#316, 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.4 beta and 0.10.6 beta, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19 then r21, D3DMetal. First rated 2 of 5 (hangs after the difficulty selection on D3DMetal, DXMT and DXVK alike) in an older environment, then 5 of 5 after installing the game into a fresh environment, in game at about 28 fps at 1920x1080 per the Metal HUD in their screenshot. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reaches play on D3DMetal on the default engine, about 28 fps at 1920x1080 on an M1 in the reporter's screenshot, but its videos hang it. The opening video and the one after the difficulty selection freeze the game a few seconds in, on every graphics mode and in a fresh environment as well as an older one, with Wine's media pipeline deadlocked in the log (a GStreamer 'gst_caps_is_fixed' assertion, then winegstreamer's media_source critical section waiting forever). One run got into the game, apparently without the video playing. The title screen's text needs Microsoft's core fonts, which the recipe installs. Whether turning Media Foundation off for BloodySpell.exe skips the videos and lets the game go on is being tested (highball-db#316). A DualSense controller was read without Steam Input on one run and only with it on the next.

knownIssues.cause: the game's fonts fall back to ones the environment does not ship
knownIssues.fix: Microsoft's core fonts, which the recipe installs

knownIssues.symptom: Freezes a few seconds into a video (the opening one, or the one after the difficulty selection), on every graphics mode
knownIssues.cause: the video deadlocks Wine's media pipeline (GStreamer caps assertion, then winegstreamer's media_source critical section waiting forever), in fresh and older environments alike
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed yet; turning Media Foundation off for BloodySpell.exe is being tested (highball-db#316)
